presentation: The source product Select is distinct from TreeSelect references: one inline search input, recent history and clear/remove actions, provider-projected code/name columns, side active-product facts aligned across the category and warehouse fields, native code tags.
Warehouse/reference filters use the shared installed TreeSelect action with source tags, inline search and informational toolbar, not bespoke title/search/footer dialogs.
Category reuses the same shared action with an explicit branch hierarchy mode backed by native parent identities.
readBoundaries: Opening empty product search shows owner-scoped recent history and performs no candidate or product read.
Typing debounces a bounded20-result native candidate query. Each subsequent page needs scroll intent; the render window stops at200 without truncating exactTotal.
Only the active suggestion reads existing target-only basics/specifications/image thumbnails. No per-row details, whole-catalog hydration or original-image prefetch.
Scopes, query attachments and style leases are effect/action owned; identity, provider, query, close and unmount invalidate stale work.
intentionalDifferences: The frozen global business bridges and all-catalog/private arrays are not copied. Search order/membership comes from the bounded native provider, not client catalog ranking.
Recent history is bounded20 and belongs to the current route/provider/identity. It is not loaded from unpartitioned legacy localStorage; only actually selected native product codes are remembered.
Legacy full-catalog multi-code paste/exact auto-selection is not emulated. Ordinary literal search remains available.

Category parent IDs mean server category-branch union. The source non-strict loaded-only cascade and inferred half-check states are not copied onto an incomplete candidate tree; unrestricted ALL-minus or parent-minus-child requests require an explicit positive replacement.
Only native parent relationships are nested. Unknown parent candidates are not invented; an orphan displays the supplied parentLabel / label path, while canonical labels and IDs remain unchanged.
Unknown price or metadata is shown as not provided, never fabricated or derived. The target-only native retail price is nullable and distinct from historical sale reference price.
Preview uses authorized thumbnails only. Source catalog full-image hover zoom is not duplicated or prefetched.
Source ShadowRoot isolation is replaced by a local host selector; the direct-input font selector is strengthened to preserve13px against later route leaf CSS. No global Arco reset is imported.
Technical explicit-selection bound is100 per native query contract. Reset remains draft-only and inventory Query remains explicit.
verificationBoundary: Source-derived DOM/CSS and scoped tests only. No real-browser screenshot, pixel, geometry, production data, database execution or visual acceptance claim.
